2501.title: Refuse a pyramid level whose depth contradicts its Z scale (fixes #2107)
2501.author: jonmarrs

pr_2501.reporter_auc_line: The issue reporter reported an ink_9um AUC of 0.54 on the truncated level 2 and 0.91–0.93 when the input was rebuilt from level 0. Those figures are the reporter's. ink_9um was not rerun: level 0 of this volume is about 19 GB, and the checkpoint is not in this environment. The pixel comparison is the ink-signal evidence.
pr_2501.credit_line: Thanks to @EhimenNathan and @AndreasHad04 for the pixel evidence.
pr_2501.review_port_and_renderer_line: No commits on main after the merge base touch the three submitted files. Main's renderer preserves depth in new renders, while the shared ink opener accepts existing inconsistent levels. This PR ports Bryant Le's rule from the stale-closed #2256 with his agreement. The separate #2282 proposal addresses rebuilding the published arrays. The runtime guard gives the flat inference workflow demonstrated in #2107 protection that main lacks. [Main renderer](https://github.com/ScrollPrize/villa/blob/c8f3ba45304f0a317a49a155929e30d294f201eb/volume-cartographer/apps/src/vc_render_tifxyz.cpp#L641-L669), [main selector](https://github.com/ScrollPrize/villa/blob/c8f3ba45304f0a317a49a155929e30d294f201eb/vesuvius/src/vesuvius/ink_detection/volume_io.py#L46-L75), [prior guard](https://github.com/ScrollPrize/villa/pull/2256), [rebuild proposal](https://github.com/ScrollPrize/villa/pull/2282).
